_readme: Vocabulary banks used by notebooks/c2_01_load_explore.ipynb to synthesize the operational half of each recipient profile. The ORGANIZATIONS are real (IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File). Their operational attributes - cold storage, capacity, pickup windows, dietary constraints - are not public for any organization, so we generate them. Phrasing is modelled on real profile text published by Seattle/King County (Public Domain) and Pennsylvania (USGOV_WORKS). Generation is seeded from each organization's EIN, so the same organization always produces the same profile on every run and for every team. See notebook Section 8.

planted_cases._readme: Deliberately planted hard cases. Section 8 of the notebook explains why each exists. These are appended to the generated corpus so every city has them, and they are what makes the difference between semantic search earning its place and merely appearing to work.
vocabulary_mismatch: We have cold chain capacity for palletized perishables and can receive at dock height.
There is a walk-in cooler out back and a second one for overflow.
We have a fridge. It is not big but it works.
Chilled holding for short-term storage of temperature-sensitive goods.

near_miss_decoy.why: Wants exactly what is on offer but physically cannot store it. A keyword match on the food type ranks this first; only the storage constraint catches it. This is the case that teaches teams the search is a candidate generator, not an answer.
near_miss_decoy.profile: Our families ask for fresh greens and salad vegetables more than anything else. We have no refrigeration of any kind - dry storage only - so we can only take produce that will be handed out the same morning it arrives.

contradiction.why: Stated capability contradicts stated capacity. Teaches teams to validate rather than trust the text.
contradiction.profile: We operate a large walk-in freezer and can accept full pallets of frozen protein. Storage is a single shelf in a shared cupboard and we have no freezer at present.

genuine_ties.why: Two organizations that are both correct answers for the same offer. Ranking becomes a judgment call, which is the point - the agent has to explain its choice, not just return a number.
profiles: Produce-focused redistribution with a walk-in cooler and a refrigerated van. We turn fresh fruit and vegetables within 48 hours and serve about 600 households a week.
